result.summary: The home screen is largely intact. The only visual defect is a small overlap of the notification badge on the bell icon.

issues.description: The red notification badge on the bell icon sits slightly outside the circular button, overlapping the button’s top-right edge instead of sitting cleanly on the corner.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the badge so it is fully contained on the icon (e.g. inset a few pixels) and does not overflow the circular button.
